reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our DM to confirm I have the note: their cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork is now 7 July, and I'll keep it between us.

I didn't save it to gbrain. Other people can read that knowledge base, and Ilse asked for privacy, so their DM is the only place the note is kept. I took no other action, as they asked.

One thing I didn't raise with them: 7 July has already passed this year (it's 14 October). They probably mean 7 July 2027, but they didn't say which year.
